description: This file implements a SOAP web service for vtiger CRM, providing methods to retrieve contact, account, lead, user, and ticket column details, as well as session management functions.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: An instance of the SOAP server handling WSDL configuration and method registration.

methods.name: get_tickets_columns
methods.description: Retrieves ticket column details if the session is valid and user has permission.

methods.name: get_contacts_columns
methods.description: Retrieves contact column details if the session is valid and user has permission.

methods.name: get_accounts_columns
methods.description: Retrieves account column details if the session is valid and user has permission.

methods.name: get_leads_columns
methods.description: Retrieves lead column details if the session is valid and user has permission.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Authenticates user and creates a session, returning session ID.
